title: The eight curve assertions and restriction to a dense open
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $X$ be a separated scheme of finite type over $k$ with $\dim X\le1$, and let $F$ be a torsion abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ which is constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion], so that $(X,F)$ is a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. Let $j:X'\hookrightarrow X$ be the inclusion of a dense open subscheme, $j^{-1}F$ the restriction of $F$ to $X'$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and $j_!j^{-1}F$ its extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], again a constructible torsion sheaf on $X_{\Et}$. Then the eight assertions $\mathcal C(X,F)$ of [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] hold if and only if $\mathcal C(X,j_!j^{-1}F)$ hold.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Section 03SB (section-vanishing-torsion), Lemma 0GJA (lemma-restrict-to-open), with Situation 0A52; the proof uses the sequence of Lemma 095L (lemma-ses-associated-to-open), Proposition 03QP and the Leray spectral sequence for the closed immersion of the finite set Z = X \ X' of k-points
